cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import glob,os,subprocess,shlex
files=sorted(glob.glob('repo-vul/src-vul/openssl/fuzz/corpora/client/*'), key=os.path.getsize, reverse=True)[:20]
for f in files:
    r=subprocess.run(['bash','/workspace/submit.sh',f,'/workspace/candidate_trace.json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    print(os.path.basename(f), 'rc', r.returncode)
    print(r.stdout.splitlines()[-1] if r.stdout else '')
    if 'exit_code' in r.stdout:
        import json
        try:
            j=json.loads(r.stdout.splitlines()[-1])
        except:
            pass
PY
